facts.claim: 主角在飞往凤凰城的航班上，邻座全程无视她
facts.quote: My obnoxious seatmate ignored me the entire flight

facts.claim: 她走出机舱、在廊桥里闻到亚利桑那的空气，被拽回少年时代
facts.quote: the moment I stepped off the plane and into that weird little elevated

facts.claim: 她的转机航班延误三小时，她发短信告诉 Abi Brooke 自己赶不上追悼会
facts.quote: my connecting flight was delayed three hours

facts.claim: 在雪松城机场她取到行李，买了外带咖啡并叫了 Uber
facts.quote: my bag was already in view. I scooped it up triumphantly

facts.claim: 一辆黑色 SUV 停到路缘，车窗已降下，车里传出说话声
facts.quote: It was a black SUV, its rear passenger window already lowered

facts.claim: 车里的女人开口叫出 Belle Currer 的名字
女人自称 Abi Brooke，是 Denny 的未婚妻
facts.quote: I’m Abi Brooke!” she exclaimed. “Denny’s fiancée.

facts.claim: Abi 解释追悼会因风会把骨灰吹进人脸而推迟到明天

relations.rel: 叙述者与 Denny 的未婚妻初次见面（此前只通过短信联系）
relations.quote: I know you said not to come, but I couldn’t help myself.

relations.rel: 未婚夫妻（Abi 自称 Denny's fiancée）
relations.quote: I’m Abi Brooke!” she exclaimed. “Denny’s fiancée.

relations.rel: Belle 推断两人同校、因而同龄（34 岁）
relations.quote: If she and Genevieve were in school together, then they had to be the same age

relations.rel: Belle 自认曾是 Denny 的"例外"（暗示二人有过关系）
relations.quote: Denny didn’t have a type. Or maybe this was his type

relations.rel: Belle 原以为 Denny 的未婚妻会是自己这副模样
relations.quote: I had assumed Denny’s fiancée would look like me.

numbers.quote: my connecting flight was delayed three hours

numbers.claim: 她在机场可自由读书的三小时
numbers.quote: I had three hours in which to read whatever I liked

numbers.claim: Uber 预计到达还需的分钟数
numbers.quote: The Uber was still six minutes away
the woman currently beaming at me was thirty-four

numbers.claim: Denny 几个月后将满的岁数
numbers.quote: (Denny would turn thirty in a few months.)

numbers.claim: Abi 比 Denny 年长的岁数
numbers.quote: She was older than him, but only by four years.

numbers.claim: 叙述者 Belle 的年龄
numbers.quote: Whereas I was forty-two and uninterested in children.

numbers.claim: 雪松城机场唯一的行李传送带数量
numbers.quote: there was only one conveyor belt for baggage claim

numbers.claim: 她说 Gila monster 只值两个词
numbers.quote: (I have two words for you: Gila monster.)

numbers.claim: 女人开口说的三个词（You're Belle Currer）
numbers.quote: a cordial ring to the three words she’d spoken

turning_point: 来接机的陌生女人原来是 Denny 的未婚妻 Abi Brooke：追悼会因风推迟，Belle 看见她的订婚戒指后仍上了她的车。
notes: Belle 与 Denny 的过往关系原文只说"I was the aberration"，未明说，属暗示；Abi 与 Genevieve 同校同龄是 Belle 的推断（"If she and Genevieve were in school together"），非叙述事实。'Denny's fiancée' 一句中的引号为弯引号，quote 按原文逐字保留。
